name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage exploration company focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Salta and Catamarca provinces of Argentina. The project hosts a large measured and indicated resource of approximately 213 Moz silver and 2.0 Moz gold. The company is actively drilling and advancing the project toward a feasibility study and potential development decision.
